Max bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. It takes twenty minutes to get to the city square by bike. Both of them like dumplings and water. In fact, a special offer runs till Sunday.
They took many photos at the city library. The city square is one of the best places in the city. Max learned a lot about music. Also, the best noodles hide in a side alley.
Max and Anna had great fun there. Max's favorite animal is the panda. Last Saturday, Max and Anna went to the city square. Best of all, take a trolley at the supermarket entrance.
Max plays tennis with Anna every Saturday. Life is full of small surprises. Max wrote about the day in the diary.
